<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net"> <diagram name="Страница-1" id="2mv9DF1Mri43-vEEGVJH"> <mxGraphModel dx="2943" dy="1880" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "---
title: Модельная диаграмма шахмат
---

classDiagram
 direction TB

 %% ========== Core / ChessTypes ==========
 namespace Core_ChessTypes {
 class Color {
 <<enumeration>>
 White
 Black
 }
 class PieceType {
 <<enumeration>>
 None
 Pawn
 Knight
 Bishop
 Rook
 Queen
 King
 }
 class Position {
 <<struct>>
 +int row
 +int col
 +isOnBoard() bool
 }
 class Move {
 <<struct>>
 +Position from
 +Position to
 +Color player
 +PieceType pieceType
 +bool isCapture
 +bool isPromotion
 +PieceType promotionTo
 }
 class MoveUndo {
 <<struct>>
 +Move move
 +bool enPassantCapture
 +int halfMoveClockBefore
 }
 }

 %% ========== Core ==========
 namespace Core {
 class GameStatus {
 <<enumeration>>
 InProgress
 Check
 Checkmate
 Stalemate
 DrawFiftyMove
 DrawThreefoldRepetition
 }
 class HistoryEntry {
 <<struct>>
 +int moveNumber
 +Color player
 +Move move
 }
 class TurnResult {
 <<struct>>
 +bool success
 +bool gameOver
 +Move move
 +GameStatus status
 +string message
 }
 class Board {
 -Piece squares_
 -Color activeColor_
 -Position enPassantTarget_
 -int halfMoveClock_
 +isLegalMove(move) bool
 +generateLegalMoves(color)
 +makeMove(move) MoveUndo
 +unmakeMove(undo)
 +getGameStatus() GameStatus
 +isKingInCheck(color) bool
 +isCastlingPathSafe() bool
 +Board(filePath)
 }
 class GameHistory {
 -HistoryEntry entries_
 -string positionKeys_
 +addMove(move, fullMoveNumber)
 +recordPosition(key)
 +countPosition(key) int
 }
 class IGameUiCallbacks {
 <<abstract>>
 +onWarning(message) void
 }
 class ChessGame {
 -Board board_
 -Player whitePlayer_
 -Player blackPlayer_
 -Player currentPlayer_
 -GameHistory history_
 -IGameUiCallbacks uiCallbacks_
 +playTurn() TurnResult
 +getBoard() Board
 +getHistory() GameHistory
 +getCurrentPlayer() Player
 +isGameOver() bool
 }
 }

 %% ========== Pieces ==========
 namespace Pieces {
 class Piece {
 <<abstract>>
 #Color color_
 #int row_
 #int col_
 #bool hasMoved_
 +isValidMove(board, toRow, toCol) bool
 +clone() Piece
 +getType() PieceType
 +getSymbol() char
 }
 class Pawn
 class Rook
 class Knight
 class Bishop
 class Queen
 class King
 class PieceFactory {
 <<utility>>
 +createPiece(type, color, row, col) Piece
 }
 }

 %% ========== Players ==========
 namespace Players {
 class Player {
 <<abstract>>
 #Color color_
 +requestMove(board, outMove) bool
 +getName() char*
 +allowsRetryOnIllegalMove() bool
 }
 class HumanPlayer {
 -IPlayerInput input_
 +requestMove(board, outMove) bool
 +allowsRetryOnIllegalMove() bool
 }
 class ScriptedPlayer {
 -Move scriptedMoves_
 -int scriptedCount_
 -int nextIndex_
 +requestMove(board, outMove) bool
 }
 class AIPlayer {
 -AIStrategy strategy_
 +requestMove(board, outMove) bool
 +setStrategy(strategy)
 }
 class IPlayerInput {
 <<abstract>>
 +readMove(board, color, outMove, error) bool
 +readPromotionChoice(color) PieceType
 }
 class ConsolePlayerInput {
 +readMove() bool
 +readPromotionChoice(color) PieceType
 -parseSquare(text, row, col) bool
 -parsePromotionChar(ch) PieceType
 }
 }

 %% ========== AI ==========
 namespace AI {
 class AIStrategy {
 <<abstract>>
 +chooseMove(board, aiColor, outMove) bool
 +clone() AIStrategy
 }
 class MinimaxAlphaBetaStrategy {
 -int searchDepth_
 +chooseMove(board, aiColor, outMove) bool
 +clone() AIStrategy
 -evaluateBoard(board, aiColor) int
 -minimax() int
 }
 }

 %% ========== UI ==========
 namespace UI {
 class ConsolePresenter {
 +printBoard(board)$ static
 +printTurnHeader(player)$ static
 +printTurnResult(result)$ static
 +printHistory(history)$ static
 +printHelp()$ static
 }
 class ConsoleUiCallbacks {
 +onWarning(message) void
 }
 class SfmlFrontend {
 -Board displayBoard_
 -Move pendingMove_
 +draw(board, sideToMove, status)
 +waitForMove(board, color, outMove) bool
 +waitForPromotion(color) PieceType
 +showEndScreen(game)
 +isOpen() bool
 }
 class SfmlPlayerInput {
 -SfmlFrontend frontend_
 +readMove() bool
 +readPromotionChoice(color) PieceType
 }
 class SfmlUiCallbacks {
 -SfmlFrontend frontend_
 +onWarning(message) void
 }
 }

 %% Struct composition
 Move \"1\" *-- \"2\" Position : from, to
 MoveUndo *-- Move
 HistoryEntry *-- Move
 TurnResult *-- Move
 TurnResult *-- GameStatus : status

 %% Board and pieces
 Board \"1\" *-- \"0..64\" Piece : squares_
 Board ..> PieceFactory : create
 PieceFactory ..> Piece : creates

 %% ChessGame
 ChessGame \"1\" *-- \"1\" Board : board_
 ChessGame \"1\" *-- \"1\" GameHistory : history_
 GameHistory \"1\" *-- \"0..*\" HistoryEntry : entries_
 ChessGame \"1\" o-- \"1\" Player : whitePlayer_
 ChessGame \"1\" o-- \"1\" Player : blackPlayer_
 ChessGame \"1\" o-- \"0..1\" IGameUiCallbacks : uiCallbacks_

 %% Players
 HumanPlayer \"1\" o-- \"1\" IPlayerInput : input_
 ScriptedPlayer \"1\" *-- \"0..*\" Move : scriptedMoves_
 AIPlayer \"1\" *-- \"1\" AIStrategy : strategy_

 IPlayerInput <|-- ConsolePlayerInput
 IPlayerInput <|-- SfmlPlayerInput
 Player <|-- HumanPlayer
 Player <|-- ScriptedPlayer
 Player <|-- AIPlayer

 %% Piece inheritance
 Piece <|-- Pawn
 Piece <|-- Rook
 Piece <|-- Knight
 Piece <|-- Bishop
 Piece <|-- Queen
 Piece <|-- King

 %% AI
 AIStrategy <|-- MinimaxAlphaBetaStrategy

 %% UI
 IGameUiCallbacks <|-- ConsoleUiCallbacks
 IGameUiCallbacks <|-- SfmlUiCallbacks
 SfmlFrontend \"1\" *-- \"1\" Board : displayBoard_
 SfmlPlayerInput \"1\" o-- \"1\" SfmlFrontend : frontend_
 SfmlUiCallbacks \"1\" o-- \"1\" SfmlFrontend : frontend_

 %% Key dependencies only
 Player ..> Board
 AIStrategy ..> Board
 ConsolePresenter ..> ChessGame
 SfmlFrontend ..> ChessGame
